strategy.primary: Rats into a Snail: every Rat entering creates or grows one Snail, and Wick's {U}{B}{R}, sacrifice a Snail deals its power to each opponent and draws that many. Type-changers (Arcane Adaptation, Leyline of Transformation, Maskwood Nexus) make the Snail a Rat, so it loops with free outlets.
strategy.secondary: Grow the Snail with Bulk Up, Lich's Relic and Blade of the Bloodchief, keep counters with The Ozolith, and run Marrow-Gnawer + Intruder Alarm; Tainted Strike turns Wick's damage into poison.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Wick, the Whorled Mind
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever Wick or another Rat you control enters, create a 1/1 black Snail creature token if you don't control a Snail. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on a Snail you control.
{U}{B}{R}, Sacrifice a Snail: Wick deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to each opponent. Then draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.

identity.why: Second type-changer, free from the opening hand.
